# serverguard24_host (Resource)

Manages a Serverguard24 host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverguard24_host" "web" {
  name    = "web.example.com"
  address = "203.0.113.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) IP address or FQDN of the host.
- `name` (String) Hostname or display name.

### Optional

- `groups` (List of Number) List of group IDs to assign this host to.

~> **Status unknown:** The groups feature appears to have no UI and no API commands to create or manage groups. This attribute is accepted by the API but group IDs cannot be obtained in practice.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Host ID.
